scientific_limitations: Only the canonical fifteen geometric matching planes of the S6 forms of the Segre cubic over finite fields of characteristic at least five. Counts are coefficient-form and point-incidence counts, not classification of further forms; equivalent earlier boundary calculations may have escaped the priority search. Computations verify exact finite combinatorial identities, with independent finite-field examples but no independent mathematical audit.
title: Frobenius incidence of the fifteen-plane boundary on Segre cubic twists
